title: Geekvape T200 Kit with Z Sub Ohm 2021 Tank Atomizer 5.5ml
description:
Geekvape T200 Kit with Z Sub Ohm 2021 Tank Atomizer 5.5ml
Geekvape T200 (Aegis Touch) Kit 200W with Z (Zeus) Sub ohm Tank 2021 5.5ml
is 2.4-inch full touch screen for more outstanding visual enjoyment. Geekvape T200 Box mod is powered by dual 18650 batteries(Sold Separately) with max 200W output & Type-C charging, supporting POWER/ TC-SS/ TC-TCR (VPC, SMART, BYPASS) modes. Geekvape T200 adopts AS-Chip 3.0 with Smart mode and New Tri-proof, IP68-rating water & dust resistance. Geekvape Z Sub-ohm 2021 Tank with top filling design.holding 5.5ml ejuice,and Widely compatible with z Series Coils.
Features:
1. 2.4-inch Full Touch Screen, 4 dynamic UI themes
2. Intelligent User Interface
3. Top Airflow
4. Z Coil With Double Service Life
5. 200W Max Output
6. Dual 18650 (not included)
7. Powered By AS Chip 3.0, Smart mode
Brand: Geekvape
Unit: 1 Set
Size: 56.05mm*31.12mm*141.25mm
Display Screen: 2.4 inch, TFT touch color screen
Battery Specification: external double battery 18650 (not included)
Resistance Range of Cartridge: 0.1 ohm – 2 ohm
Output Mode: POWER, TC-SS, TC-TCR (VPC, SMART, BYPASS)
Output Power: 5W-200W adjust 1W each time
Maximum Output Current: 45A
Maximum Output Voltage: 12V
Charging Port: Type-C Port
Operating T emperature: 10C – 60C
Storage Temperature: -30C – 70C
